title: Job Request
description: Structured work order issued by the Architect to the Engineer. The Engineer identity (Ruflo, Claude, stub) is irrelevant here — any process that accepts this schema and returns a valid Invoice can serve as the Engineer.

job_id.description: Unique identifier for this job (e.g. issue-101-20260613T120000Z).

title.description: Issue title — the Engineer's one-line task description.

body.description: Issue body — full requirements and acceptance criteria.

route.description: Model tier the Architect selected for this job based on scope.

scope.description: Architect's estimated complexity. Engineer reports scope_actual in the Invoice.

confidence.description: Classifier confidence that this issue is implementable autonomously.
